class.name: NNSTTransition
class.brief_description: Transition between active states through [method NNSTBranchNodes.send_event] or automatically on state/property changes.
class.description: Provides [member event_name] and [member to] [NodePath] export variables. The transition is performed on the parent of this node. When [member event_name] is empty the transition is automatic: it is tried when its state is entered and remains in play while that state is active. Automatic transitions are re-evaluated on the trigger types reported by their guard, never every frame.

members.member: Case sensitive event name that will trigger this [NNSTTransition]. An empty name makes the transition automatic.

method.name: get_supported_trigger_types
method.description: Returns a bit mask of [enum NNSTRoot.TriggerType] values that can trigger this transition. Non-automatic transitions support only [constant NNSTRoot.EVENT]. Automatic transitions always support [constant NNSTRoot.STATE_ENTER] and additionally the trigger types reported by their guard.

method.name: is_triggered_by
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this transition can be triggered by the given [enum NNSTRoot.TriggerType] flag.

method.name: evaluate_guard
method.description: Evaluates the guard and returns [code]true[/code] if the guard is satisfied (or if there is no guard).
